title: Xbox suffers a $1.7 billion revenue drop and bets on expanding its ecosystem
summary: Microsoft's division reports a 10% decline in revenue and a 29% drop in hardware, while its executives expect to recover growth in 2027 with an expansion to more devices.

title: Modders restore missing features of Halo: Campaign Evolved on PC and PS5
summary: The community adds split-screen and fixes launch limitations, while the mod continues to generate buzz with variants like 'Halo on helium'.

title: Gears of War: E-Day shows off its classic multiplayer without battle passes
summary: The preview reveals an old-school approach, a revamped Horde mode, and the promise that almost all content can be earned by playing.

title: GTA 6: Rumors of an imminent trailer and growing concern over its digital-only release
summary: A leaker hints at news in August, while the impact of the lack of a physical format and the expiration of digital codes in Japan is questioned.

title: Electronic Arts' $55 billion sale will close next week
summary: The deal with Saudi Arabia and private equity is about to be completed and will change the company's course.

title: Thimbleweed Park 2, Ron Gilbert's new adventure, is in development and will arrive in 2028
summary: The creator of Monkey Island is working on a LucasArts-style graphic adventure with a murder to solve, described as neither sequel nor prequel.

title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation director pushes for a physical edition
summary: Square Enix doesn't confirm the disc, but Hamaguchi hopes the game will have some physical format despite the industry's bet on digital.

title: Splatoon Raiders debuts strongly on Japanese sales charts
summary: The game receives its review on Kotaku, while Famitsu figures reflect an outstanding start in Japan.

title: Warhammer 40K Warbond for Helldivers 2 arrives August 12
summary: The collaboration will add iconic weapons like the meltagun, flamethrowers, and two Imperial Guard armor sets.

title: Saber Interactive announces Rideshare “Stimulator”, an Uber simulator, for PS5, Xbox Series, and PC
summary: The game offers a satire of ride-sharing with eccentric passengers and a city full of strange characters.

title: The Elder Scrolls Online delays major content after massive layoffs
summary: ZeniMax's new head says the game won't just be maintained, but several updates are delayed until 2027 or later.

title: Silent Hill: Townfall will take place in a Scottish town and criticize the healthcare system
summary: The new horror entry is set at the dawn of the internet and will use its story to denounce health policies.

title: Diablo 4 prepares season 15 with persistent characters and legendary items
summary: The next season will allow using the same character each season and will include classic items like the Stone of Jordan, with prior testing before BlizzCon.

title: Dungeons & Dragons announces its Universes Beyond crossover with World of Warcraft at Gen Con 2026
summary: The event also confirms the return of Dark Sun, Dragonlance, Greyhawk, and Drizzt adventures, and new mature-themed products.

title: Croc 2: Kingdom of the Gobbos will receive a remaster this year
summary: The remaster of the classic platformer will arrive on PS5, Xbox Series, PS4, Switch, and PC.

title: Path of Exile 2 gets a big update with more content and technical fixes
summary: The ARPG rival to Diablo expands its campaign with dozens of hours of gameplay and finally solves two of its most annoying technical issues.

title: Nvidia GPU prices could rise up to 30% due to the memory crisis
summary: The memory shortage, exacerbated by AI demand and Samsung's warning, makes graphics cards even more expensive.

title: A new version of Amnesia: The Dark Descent could arrive this year
summary: The horror classic could return with an installment that seeks to be faithful to the original but transform the experience.

title: Double Fine lays off 25% of its staff after separating from Microsoft
summary: The studio behind Psychonauts 2 suffers significant job cuts after becoming independent from Xbox's structure.

title: Capcom raises its profits by 81% and hints that a Pragmata sequel is likely
summary: The Japanese company celebrates exceptional financial results and points to the continuation of its science fiction franchise.

title: Shooter The Defiant adds PS5 and Xbox Series versions
summary: The game set during the Second Sino-Japanese War expands its platforms beyond PC.

title: BeamNG.drive releases its biggest update with renewed graphics and new tracks
summary: The destructible car simulator includes visual improvements, rallies, and a sports coupe in its most important patch.

title: Avatar: The Last Airbender movie almost had a much more brutal death scene
summary: A script change prevented a key moment for Aang's character from being considerably more violent.

title: Square Enix denies that Kingdom Hearts art for Switch 2 was AI-generated
summary: The localized cover of the collection was updated after players' suspicions, and the company assures that artificial intelligence was not used.

title: A new ESRB rating appears for The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time on Switch 2
summary: The change in the age rating of the remake sparks fans' interest in what it could mean.
